pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, confident dark outlines, solid uniform fill colors. No gradients, shading, perspective rendering effects or texture. The first-person pronoun 'I' expressed WITHOUT WORDS. A single person facing the viewer clearly indicates THEMSELF by touching an index fingertip to the center of their OWN upper chest. Subtle natural smile, eye contact, other hand relaxed. The fingertip clearly points inward toward the person, NOT outward. Entire standing person from head to plain slip-on shoes, large enough to read the gesture. No symbols, speech bubbles or background props. A woman with dark hair in a purple top and navy trousers pointing to herself with the index finger on her chest, a friendly direct gaze. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background, show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. IMPORTANT: zoom the composition OUT. Leave roughly ONE SIXTH of canvas width on both the left and right and generous WHITE space above and below. No object or person's extremity touches an edge. No border. Absolutely no text, lettering, digits, writing or pseudo-writing, labels, watermarks, brand marks, logos or emblems anywhere. One clear composition.
